summary: Frontend-only verification of the rewritten DashboardPage (upgraded hero, chart with range toggle, segments rings, account detail with initials avatars + vs-goal pills). Mock login (empty fields, data-testid='login-submit-btn') logs in and lands on dashboard-page. HERO: rv-invoiced-ytd renders '$11,572,416' with rv-invoiced-delta '14.7%' chip and the 168x40 sparkline (AreaChart) mounts cleanly. Segment sliding control (rv-seg-all/us/dist) switches figures correctly — US: $6,412,880 / 72% / open $5.1M ; DIST: $5,159,536 / 61% / open $4.1M ; ALL: $11,572,416 / 67% / open $9.2M. Tiles rv-tile-open/total/forecast and rv-goal-pct all update. CHART: rv-chart mounts (ComposedChart Area+Bar+Line) with no console errors. Range toggle rv-range-ytd (9 months), rv-range-q (3 months), rv-range-12m (12 months) all re-render cleanly. rv-export-btn triggers CSV download 'goorin-revenue-by-month.csv'. SEGMENTS card: rv-segment-us and rv-segment-dist both render the conic-gradient ring + progress bar; rv-top-accounts shows 5 rows with initials avatars. ACCOUNT DETAIL: rv-account-row-lids expands rv-account-expand-lids with 5 metric tiles + rv-open-account-lids link; rv-account-search filters to 1 row for 'Nordstrom'. ZERO browser console errors and no page exceptions across the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.tsx is ~355 lines and readable, but the ACCOUNTS/HEADER/SEGMENTS seed constants + helpers could be extracted to a dashboard/data.ts to keep the component focused on rendering.
The full-year forecast metric tile currently reuses a.total for both value and 'vs goal' calc; consider a distinct forecast field per account so it doesn't visually duplicate 'Conservative land'.
'220 accounts' count in the Account Detail header is hardcoded and doesn't reflect the filtered rows count — consider showing filtered/total (e.g. '5 of 220 accounts') when a search query is active.
test_credentials: Mock login: empty email+password -> click data-testid='login-submit-btn'
